text:
Maya: Quick sync — who owns the ingest-signal contract for the cost-by-token initiative? We're blocked on the events schema PR and I have a staging canary showing a tail latency spike.
Jon: Owners are Jon + Sarah. Current PR for the ingest changes is https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/428 and the event schema change is in events repo: https://github.com/redwood/events/pull/112 — both need to land before the migrator. Needs 2 approvals on instr PR.
Sarah: I noticed the canary spike this morning after the staged schema patch — p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~340ms. Snapshot from logs: ```[ingest] p50=35ms p95=340ms p99=880ms | route=kv-cache miss | model=opt-13b``` Looking into cache warming and serializer paths.
Linus: I can take PR 428 in the evening, ping me when the hotfix is up. If latency persists we should rollback schema in staging and run a 1hr smoke. @analytics-bot can you attach the trace for the canary run?
analytics-bot: CI: instr/pull/428 failed - token-cost-ingest::kvcache_integration. Exit code 1. Full CI run: https://ci.redwood/run/7890
Jon: Root cause seems to be the new event field `token_batch_id` triggering a slow serializer reflection path in the ingest lambda. I'm pushing a hotfix that switches to a handwritten fast path for that field and adding a unit test. ETA ~4h. Also adding a small backfill job to pre-warm prefix caches to avoid a cold-cache storm on rollout.
Sarah: Rollout plan suggestion: canary 10% traffic, 30m ramp, monitor p95 and error-rate. Smoke test checklist: 1) replay sample partition 2) verify prefix cache hit rate >90% 3) confirm token attribution totals within baseline ±0.5%.
Maya: Good plan. Jon, drop the updated PR link here when ready. Linus — can you drive the canary if you're around? I'm out at 3am PST. I'll add owners to the rollout config once approved.
Jon: Hotfix PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/430. Added serializer unit test and a short e2e for kvcache warming. Triggering CI now.
Linus: Reviewing now — couple tiny nits but nothing blocking. Will approve after CI green. :thumbsup:
Maya: Great — I've added you to the canary-owners rota and pinged #data-consumers about a short backfill window. Thanks everyone.
